title: Account executive
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates. As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration. We operate with an AI‑first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach. If you’re looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Purpose

The Account Executive is an individual contributor role in regional structure with direct reporting line towards Chapter Lead. The main goal for this role is to identify new business opportunities with current leads/clients and prospective new key clients which are provided against a focus target list. Account executive sells Infobip’s product/service offering to its High‑touch clients in the designated area and proactively recommend solutions to our clients. They are responsible for keeping the CRM system up to date with the information on the progress with each prospect or the client. Account Executives should work closely with relevant stakeholders internally to ensure acquisition of new business and logos.

Main Responsibilities

  • Sells a subset of product or services directly or via partners to a customers base (provided target account list) in designated geographical territory (Tier 1 (B) in region).
  • Develop solution proposals encompassing all aspects of the application.
  • Manage sales through forecasting, account resource allocation, account strategy, and planning.
  • Participate in the development, presentation and sales of a value proposition.
  • Negotiate pricing and contractual agreement to close the sale.
  • Support end-to-end client relationship for the first 12 rolling months (including NRR, cross‑sell, upsell & acquisitions).
  • Maintain a mature approach to account acquisitions for the duration of first 12 months following the service acquisition.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships and serve as a trusted partner to your clients maintain account health
  • As a Leading contributor individually and as a team member, provide direction and mentoring to others.
  • Work is non‑routine and very complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization.

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of numeric sales quotas (% of accomplishment in the set quarterly/annual numeric KPIs; CRM data)
  • Sales ROI (4x return of GP on annual cost to company with minimum of 6 new Tier 1 logos per year)
  • Approaching customers (# of related products promoted to customer; # of converted leads into opportunities in a quarter; identified # of target customers in a country)
  • Generation of new opportunities (Generation of inflow of (EUR) in pipeline, % of correct vs. errors in sales forecasts, New customer sale cycle time)
  • Reporting efficiency through timely and accurate update (clean CRM data)
  • Building relationships and networks (effective collaboration with customers/partners/internal departments, # sales meetings per year; providing help and support during events organization; timely follow‑ups (meeting minutes) in CRM)

Why you’ll love it here

  • Financial rewards & recognition — A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance‑driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
  • Flexible work arrangements — We combine in‑person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere — and not always between 9 and 5.
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) — As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
  • Work‑life balance and Well‑being — We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
  • Career mobility — Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
  • Professional development — Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow — no matter where you start.
  • International mobility — Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long‑term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.

While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well‑being, and success — wherever you are.

Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa/cursando nas áreas de Tecnologia, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharias e ou correlatas;

Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Experiência em integração de sistemas legados, familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento para Cobol, JCL e Natural;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, certificações relevantes e habilidades em testes e garantia de qualidade de softwares;

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e Manutenção: Criar e manter aplicações em Cobol, JCL e Natural, garantindo a funcionalidade e eficiência do sistema;
  • Análise de Requisitos: Colaborar com equipes de negócios para entender e traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas;

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Wellhub, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo benefícios .

Quem somos : Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
